firstLines: I'm applying for the Physician Assistant position in your emergency department. I've worked as a PA for five
years, the last four in a 48-bed emergency department at Pecanwood Health System that sees about 70,000
I'm comfortable carrying a full share of patients, usually 25 to 30 a shift, and handling the procedures that come
with them. I also care about what happens after the visit. Last year I helped write our department's pathway for
low-risk chest pain, which shortened average stays by two hours and gave patients clearer follow-up instructions.
Your posting mentions a new fast track area opening next spring. I worked in urgent care before the emergency
department and know how much a well-run fast track can take the pressure off the main department.
Thank you for considering my application. I'd be glad to shadow a shift or meet the team.
